senses.gloss: अभोग्घन् अभोग्घन्, i. e. अ-भुज्-हन्, adj. Slaying those who do not feed (the gods), i. e. who do not sacrifice, impious, Chr. 290, 3 = Rigv. 1, 64, 3.

आभोग आभोग, i. e. आ-भुज् + अ, m.
 1. Crookedness, MBh. 3, 9957; vault, Rām. 2, 65, 3; roundness, Megh. 89.
 2. Fullness, plenty, Śāk. 8, 1.
 3. The expanded hood of the Cobra capella, MBh. 16, 118.
 --Comp.
अ- + भोजन अ- + भोजन, n. abstaining from food, Man. 11, 166.
